summary: One of the first mass-produced personal computers, designed by Steve Wozniak, with colour graphics and expansion slots. VisiCalc, the first spreadsheet, made it a business machine, and the line sold for sixteen years.

events.note: The first Apple II computers go on sale.

image.alt: An Apple II magazine advertisement from December 1977
image.caption: Apple II advert in Byte, December 1977.

events.label: VisiCalc
events.note: VisiCalc, the first spreadsheet, gives people a reason to buy a computer.

events.label: Apple IIe
events.note: The Apple IIe, which becomes the longest-lived model.
Apple discontinues the Apple IIe, the last Apple II model.

cause: Discontinued as the Macintosh took over.
